subject.title: fix(agents): expose filesystem tool results in Code Mode

question: Should `ToolDefinition.outputSchema` become the supported shared contract boundary for exposing session-tool `AgentToolResult.details` to Code Mode?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused and proven, but this optional field changes the long-term API/ownership boundary for session tool definitions rather than only repairing one filesystem implementation.

options.title: Accept the shared seam
options.body: Approve the optional `outputSchema` propagation as the canonical Code Mode structured-result contract and merge after normal current-head checks complete.

options.title: Keep the contract local
options.body: Ask for a narrower filesystem-specific bridge if maintainers do not want session tool definitions to expose this shared result-schema capability.

options.title: Pause for API design
options.body: Defer the PR until the plugin/session-tool contract and documentation ownership are explicitly decided.

recommendation.title: Accept the shared seam
recommendation.body: Approve the optional `outputSchema` propagation as the canonical Code Mode structured-result contract and merge after normal current-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context shows steipete owns the proposed implementation and is assigned to the PR; feature-history ownership beyond this PR could not be established from the available material.
